zh.title: 实现 PICO 遥操作并完成 G1 真机测试
zh.summary: 打通了 PICO 头显到 G1 的遥操作控制流程。先在仿真环境中测试操作者动作到机器人动作的映射，检查控制链路与动作响应；随后将同一流程用于 G1 真机，完成初步遥操作验证。两个视频分别记录了仿真测试和真机测试，为后续示教数据采集与操作任务实验提供了基础。后续就等电机和相机采购了~

en.title: PICO Teleoperation and Initial G1 Robot Test
en.summary: I established a PICO-based teleoperation workflow for the G1 humanoid robot. I first tested the mapping from the operator's movements to the robot's movements in simulation, checking the control pipeline and motion response. I then applied the same workflow to the physical G1 for an initial teleoperation test. The two videos document the simulation and real-robot stages, providing a foundation for future demonstration data collection and manipulation experiments.

alt.en: PICO teleoperation test on the physical G1
